name: SwitchBot K10+ Pro (EU)

radios.note: SwitchBot lists 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (no 5 GHz) and Bluetooth 5.0.

matter.note: CSA lists the K10+ Pro Combo, not the plain K10+ Pro. SwitchBot's EU page says Matter needs a SwitchBot Hub 2, so the plain model reaches Matter only through the hub's bridge.

apple_home.note: EU page lists Siri and says Matter needs the SwitchBot Hub 2. The direct, hub-free Matter route (iOS 18.4.1) is documented for the Combo only.

google_home.note: Listed as working with Google Home; Matter also possible with a SwitchBot Hub.

alexa.note: Listed as working with Alexa on SwitchBot's EU page.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant page for this model found.

hubRequired.note: Connects to the SwitchBot app over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; Hub 2 is only needed for Matter, per the product page.

localControl.note: Not stated by SwitchBot in pages found.

cleaning.note: A mopping pad plate and cloth are in the box. SwitchBot says it cannot vacuum and mop at the same time.

navigation.note: SwitchBot lists LDS laser navigation (LiDAR SLAM) and PSD sensors.

suctionPa.note: From the spec table on SwitchBot's US page (600/1100/1600/3000 Pa across four modes); the EU page snippets did not show the figure.

selfEmptying.note: SwitchBot's pages describe a 4 L auto-empty dust collection base with the K10+ Pro.

summary: Apple Home only works with the SwitchBot K10+ Pro through a SwitchBot Hub 2, which provides the Matter bridge. Google Home and Alexa are listed directly on SwitchBot's EU page. The robot is compact, with LiDAR, 3,000 Pa suction and a 4 L auto-empty base, and it vacuums and mops, though not at the same time.
caveats: Matter on the plain K10+ Pro needs a SwitchBot Hub 2; the hub-free route (iOS 18.4.1) is documented only for the K10+ Pro Combo.
Wi-Fi is 2.4 GHz only; SwitchBot lists no 5 GHz support.
SwitchBot says it can't vacuum and mop at the same time.
The 3,000 Pa figure is the top of four modes (600, 1,100, 1,600, 3,000) from SwitchBot's US page.
